dialogs.text: Let me think... Which should I pick?
What are you doing?
Oh, I'm wondering what today's "Golden Dish" is going to be.
A "Golden Dish"? Is that... food that's made of gold?
No, it's a great dish that will increase the affinity of those who consume it for Mora!
Paimon wants to eat it too! Wait... But how can there be such a thing?
Haha, come, there is much you do not know.
Let's take Liyue's Mora Meat as an example. This renowned dish was named after money, and this of course strongly implies an association with financial fortune.
And there's Butter Chicken too! Its sumptuous oil just conjures up the image of a full wallet.
Another example is Mondstadt's "Pile 'Em Up"! From the name itself, it is surely a symbol of rising wealth.
So if you eat this kind of dish, then go to the Kalimi Exchange to buy some futures contracts, you'd be sure to make a killing!
The explanation sounds sort of contrived...
What are futures contracts anyway?
Never bought 'em, have you? Hmm... Let me explain it to you. It's a kind of futures trading that corresponds to spot trading. For example, this little one next to you...
Paimon is Paimon! Not some "little one"!
Hahaha! Then, little Paimon, what do you like?
Huh? Paimon likes... Um... Slimes!
Hahaha! Alright, then! Let's suppose I have a type of Slime Condensate in my hand, priced at 100 Mora a bottle.
If you buy 500 bottles of Slime Condensate from me for 50,000 Mora today, that would be considered a spot deal.
Th—That's too many! Paimon can't eat all of that!
This is just an analogy... Suppose you buy 500 bottles today. However, you can't guarantee that you will buy that much Slime Condensate from me every day, right?
Um... Well, Paimon's not gonna buy any if she's too full.
That's right, and I for my part can't guarantee that I will be able to supply you with that much Slime Condensate whenever you want.
So, this is when futures come into play. Futures are not your run-of-the-mill face-to-face trading, but a "trading agreement."
"Buying a bottle of Slime Condensate" and "selling a bottle of Slime Condensate" are both types of "trading agreements."
When I can supply Slime Condensate, I will submit a "trading agreement" to the Futures Exchange to sell that condensate.
When you need the Slime Condensate, you can go to the Futures Exchange and check the "trading agreements" to see who's selling it.
"Futures trading" involves cleverly buying and selling these "trading agreements" to reap profits.
Of course, this is just an analogy. If Slime Condensate was really traded on the futures market, all wild slimes would now be extinct.
Wow... Amazing...
Uh... I don't get it...
However! The futures market is ever-changing, and even a seasoned veteran such as I cannot guarantee that the futures I buy will profit.
But if you eat the "Golden Dish" that brings fortune before buying your futures, the situation will be different. The only question is... Which one should I eat today?
Ah, hold on, I didn't notice earlier, but your hair... It's actually the color of gold! Dazzling! Dazzling, I say!
Gold is a symbol of wealth, and so the dish *you* choose will surely bring me lots of fortune!
Why don't you help me choose a "Golden Dish"? I will repay you well.
I'll give you extra perks too if I make Mora off this. How about it?
But what if you lose...?
Hahaha! Don't worry, I, the exceptionally rich Hatim of Kalimi, hereby declare that you shall get a share of any profits and that all losses will be fully borne by me, so you can rest assured.
I see.
Come, make the choice for me, then. <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Butter Chicken</color>, or <color=#00E1FFFF>"Pile 'Em Up"</color>, which one is the real Golden Dish?
Why not eat all three?
Mix up all the good ingredients, and you shall end up with a dish most dubious. This happens distressingly often, does it not?
Fortune is like that too. Eating all of them will only be counterproductive, so we must choose the most effective "Golden Dish" to consume!
Let me think... Which should I pick?
Ah, Traveler, you're back! Wonderful!
You're not picking a Golden Dish again, are you?
Hahaha, a clever little brain you have! That's right. I'm about to pick one Golden Dish to rule all futures markets!
So, help me out again, would you?
Understood. Same rules as always?

That's right! It's been a pleasure working with you. Please make your choice then... <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Butter Chicken</color>, or <color=#00E1FFFF>Pile 'Em Up</color> — which one is the real Golden Dish?
Wait, what even is a Golden Dish?
A fabulous dish that will increase the affinity of those who consume it for Mora!
Let's take Liyue's Mora Meat as an example. This renowned dish was named after money, and this of course strongly implies an association with financial fortune.
And there's Butter Chicken too! Its sumptuous oil just conjures up the image of a full wallet.
Another example is Mondstadt's "Pile 'Em Up"! From the name itself, it is surely a symbol of rising wealth.
So if you eat this kind of dish, then go to the Kalimi Exchange to buy some futures contracts, you'd be sure to make a killing!

So, please make your choice for the sake of my "futures trading" venture. Which will it be? <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora Meat</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Butter Chicken</color>, or <color=#00E1FFFF>Pile 'Em Up</color>?
Wait, what are futures contracts anyway?
Basically, it's a future transaction, as opposed to a spot deal. Now, suppose I have a type of Slime Condensate in my hand, priced at 100 Mora a bottle.
Say you buy 500 bottles of Slime Condensate from me for 50,000 Mora. This is a spot deal.
But you can't be sure that you will make this same purchase every day, and I can't ensure that I can supply you all the time either, yes?
So, this is where futures come into play. Futures are not your run-of-the-mill, face-to-face trading, but a "trading agreement."
"Buying a bottle of Slime Condensate" and "selling a bottle of Slime Condensate" are both types of "trading agreements."
When I can supply Slime Condensate, I will submit a "trading agreement" to the Futures Exchange to sell that condensate.
When you need the Slime Condensate, you can go to the Futures Exchange and check the "trading agreements" to see who's selling it.
"Futures trading" involves cleverly buying and selling these "trading agreements" to reap profits.

flow.stepDescription: Help Hatim select a Golden Dish

dialogs.text: Oh, I can smell it! This dish smells like... wealth! Yes, it smells like gold! I shall make a killing this time, yes indeed!
Thank you so much. Now, I shall go to my "Wealth Spot" later and eat this "Golden Dish." Just wait to hear good news from me, you two!
"Wealth Spot"?
This is another one of my secret ways to get rich, and like the "Golden Dish," this is a good location that can bring me fortune.
See the city gate over there? Countless merchants carry their goods and Mora through it every day... That place must be teeming with fortunes.
Also, the area around the Exchange is also where Mora gathers. If you spend lots of time in such places, you will be blessed with wealth!
You have so many strange theories.
This all seems rather baseless...
Hahaha! Strange or not, nonsense or not, any theory that makes me Mora is a good one.
Okay, I'm ready to embrace my fortune. Wait for good news from me, Traveler!
